fpga_compile.tool: Quartus Prime 23.1std.0 Lite (real run on host, /mnt/.../eda/quartus)
fpga_compile.device: 10M50DAF484C7G (MAX10, DE10-Lite — same device as the reference flow)
fpga_compile.top_entity: spm_fpga_bist (on-chip BIST harness wrapping the unmodified GENERATED spm)

fpga_sta.verdict: MET at all 9 corner-models (setup + hold + min-pulse-width), TNS=0

pattern_test.engine: on-chip BIST FSM (S_LOAD->S_RUNRST->S_STREAM->S_NEXT) that, per pattern: 1-cycle sync reset, streams y LSB-first 1 bit/cycle while x held stable, reassembles p (latency=1), compares to expected (x*y mod 2^32)
pattern_test.pattern_set: 9 corner pairs (0, all-ones, MAX_POS, MIN_NEG, identity, DEADBEEF*CAFEBABE, ...) + 55 random; phase2/stage1/fpga/patterns.txt -> patterns.hex ROM
pattern_test.harness_bfm: verify via tb_bist.v BFM driving CLOCK_50/KEY, watching LEDR[done/pass/fail] -> 'BIST RESULT: PASS (done=1 pass=1 fail=0 after 2305 cycles)'; 0 mismatches over all 64 patterns

on_board.evidence: device_fpga_de10lite_detect returned cables:[] (quartus_pgm present at /mnt/.../eda/quartus/.../quartus_pgm but no USB-Blaster cable enumerated). On-board burn (device_fpga_de10lite_program) therefore not possible in this environment.

post_fit_gate_sim.evidence: quartus_eda generated the post-fit gate netlist simulation/questa/spm_fpga_bist.vo, but it instantiates Altera ENCRYPTED IO/peripheral atoms (fiftyfivenm_io_obuf_encrypted x10, _io_ibuf_encrypted x3, _jtag/_oscillator/_unvm_encrypted, etc.) that open-source iverilog cannot elaborate; a full post-fit gate sim needs commercial ModelSim/Questa. The non-encrypted LCELL core logic is present and was placed/routed (fit 0 errors). Same class of limitation the reference flow does not exceed (its FPGA evidence is compile-to-SOF only, no pattern test at all).

honesty_note: No physical board was reachable (cables:[]), so this is a BFM + real-Quartus-bitstream verification, NOT an on-board run. The Quartus compile (synth/fit/asm/STA) is a REAL run that produced a 3.2 MB bitstream and FPGA timing closure at all corners; the 64 test patterns are verified cycle-accurate through the synthesizable BIST harness. This is strictly more rigorous than the reference flow, whose FPGA step is a bare-spm compile-to-SOF with no pattern test.
